drugs.name: Ruxolitinib Cream (Opzelura)
drugs.mechanism: Topical selective JAK1 and JAK2 inhibitor interrupting IFN-gamma / CXCL10 signaling to halt melanocyte destruction and allow follicular repigmentation
drugs.efficacy: First FDA-approved pharmacotherapy for nonsegmental vitiligo achieving >=75% facial repigmentation (F-VASI75)
drugs.adverse_effects: Application site acne, application site pruritus, nasopharyngitis, headache

drugs.name: Tacrolimus Ointment
drugs.mechanism: Calcineurin inhibitor suppressing T-cell activation and NFAT-dependent cytokine transcription without skin atrophy
drugs.efficacy: Highly effective for facial and cervical vitiligo, especially when combined with sunlight/phototherapy
drugs.adverse_effects: Transient burning, stinging, erythema at application site

drugs.name: Clobetasol Propionate
drugs.mechanism: Ultra-high potency glucocorticoid receptor agonist suppressing cytotoxic T-cell infiltrates at lesion borders
drugs.efficacy: First-line therapy for non-facial actively spreading vitiligo macules
drugs.adverse_effects: Skin atrophy, telangiectasias, striae, hypertrichosis with prolonged use
